scope: Historical apparatus and uncertainty source binding; not a new AOD prediction or current clock performance claim

primary.title: First accuracy evaluation of NIST-F2
primary.method: Web PDF text; source line anchors; no visual scan verification

clock_transition.clock_pair_source: F2 uses F1 architecture; F1 2005 section5.2 explicitly identifies the pair; F2 field-mapping discussion identifies prepared |3,0> population

method: Laser-cooled atomic fountain; two Ramsey interactions with applied microwave field; optical population readout; line servo

measurement_stages.source: F2 section2.1,3.6.2 and related F1 papers
measurement_stages.binding: State-selection microwave cavity in shielded region; mF=0 clock preparation, residual populations evaluated
Ramsey cavity crossed on ascent and descent; nominal pulse area tau/4 radians
Two optical detection zones; collected fluorescence, photodiodes, amplifiers; F=4/F=3 populations
measurement_stages.qualification: Physical population estimates need detector/background calibration; not automatically exact integer atom counts

measurement_stages.source: F2 section3.2 square-wave servo; F1 2002 section2.4 detailed architecture
measurement_stages.binding: Difference of normalized populations on two sides of resonance gives line-centre error signal
Experiment-specific shifts, density extrapolation, reference/time-transfer handling

LN2_fill_interval_hours.source: F2 section2.1; operation paused a few minutes

reference_chain.H_maser_role: Reference for phase-locked synthesis and flywheel during long evaluations
chain_nominal: single-sideband mixer with nominal7.368 MHz computer-controlled synthesizer

typical_Table1.source: F2 Table1,p179; typical30dayevaluation, some inputs measured earlier

August2013.reason_differs_from_Table1: Microwave synthesizer modified; amplitude effects re-evaluated over shorter interval

calibration_and_prediction_scope.covariance: Track shared uncertain maser/reference/transfer data; exact Cs definition itself creates no covariance
calibration_and_prediction_scope.GR_boundary: Paper's gravity/Doppler reduction is recorded as experimental methodology, not adopted as an AOD dynamical premise
